exclusion_detail: Lead 17b is made from the monovalent inhibitor 7 (Y06037), which the paper says was 'synthesized according to our previous protocol [64]' with no procedure in this paper; no SI in the bundle. The two final steps (ditosylation of a PEG diol, then double alkylation of 7) are explicit but 7 is a made-with-citation starting material.

lead.label: 17b (Y13021)
lead.why: Abstract: 'The representative bivalent inhibitor 17b effectively inhibited the cell growth of LNCaP, exhibiting 32 folds more potency than monovalent inhibitor 7.'

notes: All final compounds (12, 14, 15, 17 series) derive from 7, whose preparation is only cited. Intermediates 8a/8b/9a/9b are 2 steps from 7, equally dependent on 7.
